game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ash barrier.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ash barrier. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about power_on to power up the fire warden and open the ash barrier.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
